resources.string: Cannot connect to the Transify backend server. Please verify your network connection and ensure the server is online.

The Transify application requires a valid HTTPS deployment URL.

Please rebuild using:
./gradlew assembleDebug -PTRANSIFY_BASE_URL=https://your-domain

Or enter your deployed server URL below for this session:
Transify needs camera access for live sign language tracking and recognition.
Transify needs microphone access for speech-to-text recognition.
Storage access is required to save translated files.
